# Medium
> Medium is a publishing platform for reading, writing, and distributing articles, essays, and newsletters across many topics.

Medium hosts publications, individual writers, member-only stories, newsletters, and creator tools for publishing and audience growth. Its public site includes editorial collections, help resources, partner program information, and policy pages relevant to readers and writers.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://medium.com/): Main entry point for reading featured stories, topics, and publications.
- [About Medium](https://medium.com/about): Overview of Medium’s mission, platform model, and publishing ecosystem.
- [Topics](https://medium.com/topics): Directory of major subject areas and topic-based reading feeds.
- [Publications](https://medium.com/publications): Directory for discovering curated publications hosted on Medium.
- [Partner Program](https://medium.com/creators): Overview of monetization and creator-focused publishing opportunities on Medium.
- [Membership](https://medium.com/membership): Information about paid membership benefits for readers and writers.

## Reading and Discovery
- [Technology](https://medium.com/topic/technology): Topic page aggregating technology-related stories from across Medium.
- [Business](https://medium.com/topic/business): Topic page featuring business, startups, management, and finance writing.
- [Culture](https://medium.com/topic/culture): Topic page for essays and commentary on culture and society.
- [Politics](https://medium.com/topic/politics): Topic page collecting political analysis, opinion, and reporting.
- [Self Improvement](https://medium.com/topic/self-improvement): Topic page for productivity, habits, and personal development content.
- [Science](https://medium.com/topic/science): Topic page for science writing, research explainers, and commentary.

## Writing and Publishing
- [Write on Medium](https://medium.com/m/signin?operation=register): Sign-up flow for creating an account and starting to publish.
- [New Story](https://medium.com/new-story): Editor entry point for drafting and publishing a new story.
- [Become a Member](https://medium.com/membership): Membership page covering reader access and writer support features.
- [Creators](https://medium.com/creators): Creator hub for writing, audience growth, and earning information.
- [Partner Program Guide](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/360001411093-Medium-Partner-Program): Help section for earning eligibility, payouts, and program rules.
- [Publications Help](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000487787-Publications): Help resources for creating and managing publications.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.medium.com/): Main support portal for readers, writers, and publication owners.
- [Writing and Publishing](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000487067-Writing-and-publishing): Support articles about drafting, formatting, and publishing stories.
- [Account and Profile](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000487227-Your-account): Help articles for account settings, profiles, and sign-in issues.
- [Medium Partner Program](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/360001411093-Medium-Partner-Program): Support documentation for monetization, payouts, and tax-related topics.
- [Membership](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/360001411133-Medium-Membership): Help articles about subscriptions, billing, and member access.
- [Publications](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000487787-Publications): Support content for publication editors, writers, and customization.
- [Rules and Policies](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001661653-Rules-and-Policies): Policy-oriented help content covering platform rules and enforcement.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://medium.com/policy/medium-terms-of-service-9db0094a1e0f): Terms governing use of Medium’s platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://medium.com/policy/medium-privacy-policy-f03bf92035c9): Policy describing data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Rules](https://medium.com/policy/medium-rules-30e5502c4eb4): Platform rules covering prohibited content and account behavior.
- [Distribution Standards](https://medium.com/policy/distribution-standards-8e1014cfd670): Standards used to determine recommendation and distribution eligibility.
- [Friend Links Policy](https://medium.com/policy/friend-links-policy-5f4c7f0c6f5): Policy describing access and usage rules for friend links.
- [Copyright Policy](https://medium.com/policy/medium-copyright-policy-bfa1a4a5f1e7): Information about copyright complaints and takedown procedures.

## Newsletters and Publications
- [Newsletters](https://medium.com/newsletters): Directory of newsletters available through Medium.
- [The Medium Blog](https://blog.medium.com/): Official Medium blog with product, company, and platform updates.
- [OneZero](https://onezero.medium.com/): Publication focused on technology, science, and the future.
- [Elemental](https://elemental.medium.com/): Publication centered on health, wellness, and evidence-based living.
- [GEN](https://gen.medium.com/): Publication covering politics, power, identity, and culture.
- [ZORA](https://zora.medium.com/): Publication focused on Black life, culture, and commentary.
- [Human Parts](https://humanparts.medium.com/): Publication featuring personal essays, relationships, and emotional life.

## Business and Creator Programs
- [Medium for Writers](https://medium.com/creators): Central hub for creator tools, guidance, and earning opportunities.
- [Partner Program Overview](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/115011927148-About-the-Medium-Partner-Program): Introductory article explaining how the Partner Program works.
- [Getting Paid](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036691193-Getting-paid-for-your-stories): Help article on writer earnings and payment mechanics.
- [Writer Dashboard Help](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/360006362473-Your-Partner-Program-dashboard): Documentation for understanding Partner Program dashboard metrics.
- [Membership Referrals](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/360006095813-Share-Medium-with-your-friends): Help article about referral-related sharing and membership promotion.
- [Publications on Medium](https://help.medium.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000483448-Create-a-publication): Guide to creating and operating a publication on Medium.

## Company and Contact
- [Careers](https://medium.com/jobs-at-medium/work-at-medium-959d1a85284e): Information about working at Medium and open roles.
- [Press](https://medium.com/press): Press resources and company information for media inquiries.
- [Contact Support](https://help.medium.com/): Support portal for account, billing, and publishing assistance.
- [Accessibility](https://medium.com/policy/accessibility-at-medium-4c907fdbf065): Medium’s accessibility commitments and support information.
- [Status on X](https://x.com/MediumSupport): Public support channel for service and account-related updates.
